## v1.2.0

### Repository health

- Added a single health engine that scores every watched repository and feeds a dedicated health section on the repository detail page.
- The health section surfaces the alerts, failed workflows and stale activity that drive the score, so you can see why a repository needs attention.

### View modes on repository pages

- Repository pages now support Balanced, Detailed and Full viewing.
- Balanced keeps workflows, dependencies and activity compact; Detailed lists them in full; Full adds run history, the dependency context and a contributors overview.

### Real repository logos

- Watched repositories no longer show a generic GitHub social-preview card.
- The app now looks for each repository's real logo: known brand assets, Tauri icons on desktop, common paths, and GitHub Pages home pages (including assets referenced by the built JavaScript/CSS bundles).
- When no logo exists, the avatar falls back to the repository initials.

### Desktop window polish

- Fixed titlebar dragging in the custom window frame on desktop.

### Workflow runs

- Added a dedicated workflow run detail panel with richer per-run information.

### Release pipeline

- Releases now run through the reusable Release Core protocol (mafhper/release-core) with English editorial notes.
- New release artwork for the 1.2 line.
